in_english.name: Shamael
in_english.meaning: beautiful, good, handsome, one of the names of Prophet Muhammad
in_english.long_meaning: The name Shamael is derived from the Arabic root 'sh-ml', which means to gather or collect. It signifies beauty, goodness, and is one of the names attributed to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), reflecting his comprehensive and perfect character. This name embodies the qualities of mercy, compassion, and wisdom associated with the Prophet. Shamael is used across various Muslim cultures to denote someone who embodies these noble attributes

data.cultural_impact: The name Shamael holds significant cultural relevance in the Islamic world, as it is believed to be the name of an angel in Islamic lore. Angels, in Islamic belief, are celestial beings created by Allah (God) to serve Him in various capacities. The name Shamael is not mentioned in the Quran, but it is mentioned in various Hadiths, the sayings and actions of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and in Sufi literature. According to these sources, Shamael is an angel responsible for overseeing and recording human actions, acting as a weigher of deeds and a guardian of paradise.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Shamael can be traced back to its original meaning: 'the one who watches over God and His creation.' This meaning emphasizes Shamael's role as a faithful servant of Allah, constantly observing and maintaining the balance between Allah's creation. This idea resonates with the Islamic belief in accountability and the importance of each individual's role in serving and appreciating Allah. The name Shamael serves as a reminder of the constant presence of Allah and the importance of remaining mindful of our actions and intentions. It further highlights the idea of, in the words of the Quran, "Allah is the One who observes you (of your deeds)" (Quran 4:110). Thus, the name Shamael holds deep spiritual significance as it embodies the idea of watching over and serving Allah, inspiring individuals to strive for righteousness and devotion to their Creator.
